other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Assam
Must be engaged in any building or other construction work
Must be registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have worked as a building worker for at least one year before reaching 60 years of age
benefits_summary: A pension of ₹2,000 plus ₹100 for each completed year of service, payable from the month after the worker turns 60 years old.
